title: Quietly Juicy Greek Fregola Stifado
description: A peppery and juicy Greek dish featuring fregola, shaped like nigiri, this stifado is a cozy and delicious meal option, and can be adapted to be raw friendly.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fregola and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomato paste, red wine, beef broth, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use a small ice cream scoop or spoon to shape the stifado into nigiri shapes.
Serve the stifado hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill.
To make this dish raw friendly, replace the cooked fregola with raw fregola and do not cook the stifado.
Chill the stifado in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
